transformations: LARA line intensity and intensity uncertainty in percent are divided by 100 for per-parent yields. The source percent strings are retained alongside each line.
PenNuc yields and their uncertainties are already per parent; copy without normalization.

MIRD MeV energies are mapped through the existing GGEMS nearest-meV embedding: round_half_up(MeV * 1e9) / 1e6 keV. The raw MeV string is retained. Canonical Energy for comparison is then energy_keV * 1e9 micro-eV.

Only the first Auger line changes energy under this existing embedding: 0.0000789857 MeV -> 0.078986 keV (positive 300 micro-eV residual). This package records the mapping; it does not correct production physics.
Sort each group's lines by increasing energy. Preserve the current group order: Alpha, Gamma (nuclear), Gamma (X-ray), Electron (Auger), Electron (conversion main), Electron (conversion weak).
Partition conversion lines at absolute yield 1e-9 per parent: main >= 1e-9; weak < 1e-9. This is the existing numerical ticket representation, not two physical decay branches.
Group yields are exact sums of physical line yields. Only conditional line probabilities used for sampling divide by a group sum; physical yields are never normalized.
provenance.uncertainty_policy: Preserve available reported line uncertainties and missing values. PenNuc zero uncertainty fields are copied as reported, not interpreted as proof of exactness. No covariance or combined group uncertainty is invented. Statistical comparisons condition on the selected central values and mapped energies.
